description:
## 📝 Summary
Fixed critical bug in vault plugin where \`CopyOnWriteDict.model_dump()\` returned empty dictionary instead of actual headers, preventing vault token extraction and injection in production environments.

**Root Cause:** The plugin was using \`payload.headers.model_dump()\` which returns an empty dict in production (with real HTTP requests), though it works in unit tests.

**Solution:** Changed to use \`payload.headers.root\` attribute directly for reliable header access.

**Additional Enhancement:** Added case-insensitive HTTP header lookup to comply with RFC 7230.
Related to https://jsw.ibm.com/browse/ICACF-42
                  https://jsw.ibm.com/browse/ICACF-41
---

**Manual Integration Tests:** All 5 scenarios passing

- ✅ Graceful handling without vault tokens

- Line 188: Changed \`payload.headers.model_dump()\` → \`payload.headers.root\`

**File: \`tests/unit/mcpgateway/plugins/plugins/vault/test_vault_plugin.py\`**

### Test Coverage

- **New tests prevent:** CopyOnWriteDict regression, case sensitivity issues, config/request mismatches"

commits.message:
fix: vault plugin CopyOnWriteDict header access bug

- Changed payload.headers.model_dump() to payload.headers.root for correct header access
- CopyOnWriteDict.model_dump() returns empty dict, must use .root attribute
- Added case-insensitive HTTP header lookup (RFC 7230 compliant)
- Fixes vault token extraction and injection in production environments

The bug was not caught by unit tests because they already used .root directly.
This fix aligns the plugin code with the correct access pattern.

Tested with manual integration tests - all 5 scenarios passing:
- Session initialization
- OAuth2 token injection
- PAT token injection
- Graceful handling without vault tokens
- Vault header security stripping

Signed-off-by: popagruia <adrian.popa@ro.ibm.com>
commits.author: popagruia

commits.message:
test: add comprehensive vault plugin tests for case-insensitive headers

- Added test_case_insensitive_vault_header_detection: validates RFC 7230 compliance with 4 case variations
- Added test_copyonwritedict_root_attribute_access: validates .root attribute usage and documents the fix
- Added test_case_insensitive_header_with_config_variations: validates all 7 combinations of config/request header case
- All 15 vault plugin unit tests passing (12 original + 3 new)

The new tests validate:
1. Case-insensitive header matching (X-Vault-Tokens, x-vault-tokens, X-VAULT-TOKENS, etc.)
2. Correct use of .root attribute for header access (prevents CopyOnWriteDict.model_dump() regression)
3. All combinations of config header case vs request header case
4. Preservation of custom headers during token injection

These tests would catch similar bugs early in development.

Signed-off-by: popagruia <adrian.popa@ro.ibm.com>
commits.author: popagruia

commits.message:
fix: Add missing auth_value field to gateway cache payload

The gateway_payload dictionary in _build_tool_cache_payload() was missing
the auth_value field, causing Pydantic validation to fail when the vault
plugin tried to read gateway metadata from cache. This prevented the plugin
from determining the system key for vault token lookup.

The auth_value field is required by the Gateway Pydantic model but was not
being included in the cache serialization, even though it exists in the
database.

Fixes vault plugin system key determination for cached gateway metadata.

Signed-off-by: popagruia <adrian.popa@ro.ibm.com>
commits.author: popagruia
